zones.title: Cancel gate
zones.body: Rules in order: already cancelled; no appointment in hand; a different reference; not confirmed (state CONFIRM_CANCEL from the previous turn). Only Proceed cancels.

zones.title: Cancel
zones.body: POST cancel on the DealerBook booking id; cancelledAt and state CANCELLED on the session. DealerBook confirms to the customer.

panels.title: AR-25 CancelAppointment
panels.body: Same two-turn rule as a booking: read-back in CONFIRM_CANCEL, cancellation only after the caller's yes in the next turn. The call is a POST on the DealerBook booking id (endpoint sheet, 2026-10-23; host api-dev there, open). DealerBook confirms the cancellation to the customer.
